'''Seapunk''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Seapunk}}
{{Intents Table/row

|Effect = Deals (11;{{Asc2|9|13}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row

|Intent = Attack2

.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bubble Burp
|Intent = Buff, Defend

}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Cycles through its moves in a fixed order:
# {{Int2|Seapunk|Sea Kick}}
# {{Int2|Seapunk|Spinning Kick}}
# {{Int2|Seapunk|Bubble Burp}}
# Back to {{Int2|Seapunk|Sea Kick}}
